FN-FKWI4CC-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 134
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Billy Beasley
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/15/2026
Senate Bill 134 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
require interstate warehousers to obtain a permit from the Department of Revenue (DOR) to
operate in this state. This would increase receipts to DOR by an undetermined amount
dependent on the number of $2,000 application fees and the $500 annual permit fees that are
collected from interstate warehousers, as provided by this bill.
Further, this bill also adds a minimum penalty of $250 per article on the second violation and
updates the maximum $500 per article to include the third and subsequent violations for persons
failing to properly affix the required stamps to any tobacco products. This bill would provide
additional penalties of $1,000 multiplied by the total number of violations for any person who
violates the requirements of an interstate warehouser which would increase receipts to the State
General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of the penalty assessed and
the number of violations committed.
